question: Locate i24 truecolor regression and contrast Unicode using exact retained binaries; no new optimization or runtime promotion.

pilot.purpose: Validate exact test thread arming, sample mapping, symbolization. Excluded from confirmatory summaries.

measurement.order: Rotate four arms left by round index, reverse on odd round; workloads truecolor then unicode each round.
measurement.same_binaries: retained i24 exact identities; no build

attribution: CPU-time signal samples across whole test thread, including setup and all internal rounds; report exclusive symbol shares and top exact machine-instruction addresses. Not stacks, retired instructions, kernel attribution, timed-pass attribution or causal lost time. Engine::apply conditional hotspot distribution is diagnostic.
observer: Compare profiled/plain paired CPU-rate ratios separately per exact binary and workload, plus plain candidate/control; three pairs descriptive only. No significance/promotion gate.
limits: Shared host; fixed AB rotations do not establish iid. Requested sample period may be below actual timer resolution. No stack sampling, source lines, runtime edit, terminal/Ghostty timing or title claim.
stop: Exactly one pilot and 24 confirmatory sessions if pilot valid; failure retains incomplete evidence and stops, no variant/extra pairs/rescue pooling.
